page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-90-lssd is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 90 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 45 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 360 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 3216 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 8 local drives.

Benchmark results place the multi-core processing capabilities of this instance in the top tier, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and software compilation tests. Single-core performance is strong to average, with Geekbench single-core scores in the middle 50% and stress-ng single-core in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth is strong for read operations, reaching 6372.53 GB/sec for cached small blocks, though large block write bandwidth falls into the average category.

The combination of high-density multi-core compute and 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage makes this instance suitable for database operations, software compilation, and static web serving, where it achieves strong benchmark ratings. It also supports vector instructions including AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration. While it handles prompt processing for small and medium language models efficiently, text generation speeds for larger models remain average, reflecting the absence of dedicated GPU hardware.
